Who supplied the titanium dioxide?.answer: Multiple suppliers were used: Cosmo Chemical Co. (TiO2), Sejong Materials (TiH2), BASF (Fe), Alfa Aesar (Mn), Korea carbon black Co. (C).

What temperature was used for TiH2 proce.answer: TiH2 route processing temperatures: 1373K (5 min) or 1473K (5 min), heating rate 50 K/min.

What hydrogen capacity was achieved in t.answer: Third cycle (303K): Best performance with 1.17 wt% H for 50-300 min, highest hydriding rate achieved.

What phases were detected by XRD?.answer: Main phases detected: FeTi and Fe2Ti (hydrogen storage phases), TiC (TiO2 route), FeTiO3 (intermediate), FeMn3 (TiH2 route).

What are the ball milling conditions?.answer: Ball milling balls: 6 mm diameter stainless steel, 1,260 g total weight.

Which institutions conducted this resear.answer: Research institutions: KIMS (Korea Institute of Machinery and Materials) and Chonbuk National University.

What is the advantage of TiH2 over TiO2?.answer: TiH2 route advantages: no carbon contamination, lower processing temperature, cleaner reaction, more FeTi/Fe2Ti phases.
